## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths before matching — With `report={"failed": ["./tests/test_x.py"]}` and `requested={"tests/test_x.py"}`, you return `[]` instead of the failed path. Existing selectors normalize paths before matching, and `select_explicit` demonstrates how to preserve their original spelling. — Callers receive an incomplete selection of failed tests when runner reports use dot-prefixed paths. — Fix: Match with `normalize(path) in requested`, retain the original path, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.
